title: NLTK: XMLCorpusView comment and CDATA parsing permits quadratic CPU denial of service (CVE-2026-128139)
description: NLTK versions 3.6 through 3.10.3 contain a vulnerability in the XMLCorpusView streaming XML reader where processing XML files with large comment or CDATA sections can cause a quadratic CPU denial of service. This occurs because the XML parsing function repeatedly performs expensive regex validations on growing buffers while reading the XML in 1 KiB blocks. The issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.
